why: Only Macworld and PCWorld are real testers, and they run broad cable roundups that answer the question only in part. The rest are affiliate or aggregation listicles, single-brand pages and retailer listings. No major reviewer has tested 240W and 40Gbps together, so a focused page with verified specs and current prices could stand out.
